chapter: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants
act_title: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants

quests.title: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants

dialogue.t: Hmm... Yeah. That's the big guy from before, though we didn't get a good look at him before... And to be honest, he doesn't look much like a giant Snegovik...
Paimon didn't know they could grow that huge.

dialogue.sit: Something might have gone haywire somehow...
It would be nice if you could grow up like that, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Haywire, you say... So were those chains meant to keep him from losing control? Still, it's so sad that he's had to live like that.
Also, does... does he want to go out to sea?
Hmm. Big Guy over there hasn't gone around causing any damage... Kinda weird, really. Where does he want to go, exactly?

quests.description: The giant once bound by chains upon the tundra has appeared by the sea… Where does he intend to go?
